scope: Public BOSE DataFrame selectors, standard-column dependencies and signed boundary mapping
findings: Activity projection still depends on standard case and timestamp columns when custom selectors are supplied.
Custom activity values control the projected labels; selected case and timestamp columns separately control change-timestamp lookup.
A selected case column yielding fewer groups can cause a post-permutation index error even though standard-case projection succeeds.
Boundary zero does not generate an empty returned frame; out-of-range timestamp boundaries can reject after RNG consumption.
Negative group sizes can return no frames while still returning change timestamps for accepted signed detector boundaries.
limits: Finite public contract evidence, not native DataFrame adapter parity.
Dtype/null and non-string scalar behavior remain under investigation.
No module or dispatcher coverage status promotion.
